descriptions.job-044icao:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Solutions Architect on TRM's Onchain Compliance team, you are the technical owner of the sales cycle for crypto exchanges, banks, fintechs, and payments companies. You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it.

The impact you will have:

  • Own the technical win on strategic onchain compliance deals, using TRM's platform and AI-assisted workflows to turn each customer's compliance process into an architecture they trust. This directly determines whether TRM lands and keeps tier 1 accounts.

  • Compress time to value by building tailored, AI-assisted demos within days of discovery, showing compliance teams how TRM plus AI cuts manual alert review.

  • Design and prove API integrations that fit real compliance operations, including alert triage, case management, and escalation, and use AI tooling to prototype them quickly.

  • Build reusable, AI-enabled demo and integration assets so every deal moves faster than the last and the team scales without adding manual work.

  • Feed field insight back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap so TRM stays ahead of what compliance teams need next.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years in pre- and post-sales technical roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer), increasingly using AI tools in your workflow.

  • Hands-on experience scoping, implementing, and supporting API-based SaaS integrations, including using AI to prototype and test them faster.

  • Comfort with REST APIs and scripting in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and with AI coding assistants to build quick prototypes.

  • Familiarity with AML, KYC, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, and interest in applying AI to speed compliance review.

  • Daily use of AI tools with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it.

  • Strong discovery, prioritization across several opportunities at once, and clear communication with both engineers and senior compliance leaders.

  • Bonus: blockchain fundamentals, crypto compliance regulation, or experience building AI-enabled workflows. If you are excited by the mission but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply.

About the Team:

  • Solutions Architecture at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that works asynchronously through Slack and detailed documentation.

  • The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering.

  • The work is intellectually demanding. You translate complex compliance and blockchain problems into clear solutions under real deal pressure.

  • Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Primary overlap 8:00am to 5:00pm ET for customer syncs and team collaboration.

  • Weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and account POD calls, with regular direct customer engagement.

  • Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

  • Travel 20 to 30 percent for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core overlap 8:00am to 5:00pm ET.

On-Call Responsibilities:

  • Schedule: No formal on-call rotation.

  • Frequency: Occasional off-hours escalations for live customer incidents (HM to confirm at intake).

Travel Requirements:

  • Schedule: As needed for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

  • Frequency: 20 to 30 percent.

Onsite Requirements:

  • Schedule: Occasional customer onsite visits.

  • Frequency: HM to confirm at intake.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within days of discovery, you put a demo built around the customer's compliance workflow in front of them, not a generic walkthrough.

  • Within days of a customer's commitment, you have agreed success criteria and a live pilot environment.

  • In the first 90 days, you build reusable demo and integration assets that cut setup time on the next deal.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Legal Counsel to join us on a 3-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of extension depending on business needs.

In this role, you will work closely with our Commercial, Product, Compliance, Regulatory, Finance, and Operations teams to structure, review, and negotiate complex and bespoke commercial and partnership agreements. You will play a key role in supporting transactions across the payments, fintech, and Web3 ecosystem, balancing commercial objectives with legal, regulatory, and compliance considerations.

This role is well suited for an experienced commercial lawyer who can operate independently, manage transactions end-to-end, and provide practical legal advice in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Do

  • Lead the drafting, structuring, reviewing, negotiation, and execution of complex commercial and partnership agreements, particularly within the payments, fintech, and Web3 ecosystem.
  • Handle agreements with a range of counterparties, including banks, payment service providers, exchanges, wallets, custodians, fintech companies, and other digital asset/Web3 partners.
  • Take end-to-end ownership of commercial transactions and contract negotiations with minimal supervision.
  • Partner closely with Commercial, Product, Compliance, Regulatory, Finance, and Operations teams to understand business requirements, identify potential risks, and ensure relevant legal and compliance considerations are appropriately reflected in agreements.
  • Provide timely and practical advice to internal stakeholders regarding contractual obligations, commitments, and commercial legal matters.
  • Advise management and business stakeholders on complex client and partnership matters, including potential contractual, regulatory, compliance, financial, and legal risks.
  • Communicate complex legal considerations clearly and concisely, adapting your approach to different stakeholders and audiences.
  • Support the development and improvement of contracting processes, templates, playbooks, and procedures to increase operational efficiency.

What We Are Looking For

  • Qualified lawyer in a common law jurisdiction with at least 5 years of relevant legal experience, with strong experience in commercial contracts gained in-house and/or at a reputable law firm.
  • Strong commercial contracting experience, including independently drafting, reviewing, structuring, and negotiating complex agreements.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to combine legal analysis with practical commercial judgment.
  • Ability to independently manage multiple transactions and priorities in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
  • Highly collaborative and solutions-oriented, with strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex legal concepts and risks into clear, practical, and commercially relevant advice.
  • Strong time management skills and the ability to deliver quality work under tight deadlines.
  • Available to start as soon as possible and commit to a minimum 3-month contract.

  • Execute end to end on GPX products, from discovery and requirements through shipping and iteration alongside ASG engineers
  • Improve the systems behind LP reporting, capital activity communications, and firm performance updates
  • Shape workflows and tooling that support fundraising, LP relationship management, and access to firm content and events
  • Handle sensitive LP and performance data with rigor and discretion, and bring a strong point of view on data governance

  • Represent GPX's needs in ASG's broader roadmap, and bring ASG's product practice to a relationship-driven, non-technical team

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to build trust quickly across investing, GPX, and engineering

About Helius

Helius is building the core infrastructure for Solana - empowering developers to create the next generation of crypto-powered applications. Our mission is to accelerate the development of internet capital markets by making it easier, faster, and more intuitive to build on-chain.

 

Thousands of teams - from early-stage startups to industry leaders like Coinbase, Phantom, and Jupiter - rely on Helius APIs, webhooks, and indexing tools to power their products. Backed by Haun Ventures, Founders Fund, and Foundation Capital, we’re a small, senior team obsessed with performance, simplicity, and scalability in decentralized systems.

Read our Helius Manifesto to see how we work and what we value.

About the Role

Your job is to increase the productivity of our customers and increase adoption of Helius products. You’ll be part of Helius’s new Developer Relations team focused on our data platform: LaserStream, RPC, webhooks, and our APIs. This is technical marketing in the best sense. You create value for developers by explaining things well, building things worth copying, and helping people when they're stuck.

You'll make tutorials, demo apps, videos, and technical content across the Helius data platform. You'll use our products the same way customers do, so what you publish actually works, and the advice you give holds up.

You'll be one of the public faces of Helius. Solana developers live on Discord, Telegram, and X, and so will you. Nobody is going to hand you a content calendar. We expect you to find where developers get stuck and pitch what to build, instead of being told what to do.

What You'll Do

  • Write code tutorials and technical deep dives on building with Solana data

  • Build demo applications, starter repos, and SDK examples across LaserStream, RPC, webhooks, and APIs

  • Make videos and tutorials, either on your own or with our designers when you want higher production value

  • Be active where Solana developers are: Discord, Telegram, X, and GitHub. Answer questions, unblock people, be useful in public

  • Go to hackathons and conferences to run workshops, judge projects, and help builders in person

  • Bring developer feedback to engineering and product, then tell the community when we've shipped fixes

  • Work with ecosystem partners like protocols, tooling teams, and educators

  • Keep score on what's working: content reach, demo adoption, developer activation, community growth

  • Own developer-facing communications for the data platform, including customer outreach and Agave upgrade announcements

What You'll Bring

  • 2+ years of professional experience at a technology-first company, ideally in developer tooling or infrastructure

  • Hands-on engineering experience. You're comfortable writing code and can easily relate to the engineers who use Helius

  • Excellent technical writing and oral communication. You can take a complex problem and make it easy to understand for a broad audience

  • You can produce across formats: written tutorials, demo apps, SDKs, video

  • A portfolio we can review before we talk: tutorials, videos, repos, talks, or threads you've already made

  • Community-oriented. You live on Discord, Telegram, and X, and you have your own network and personal brand

  • Willingness to travel. The Solana calendar is global, and hackathons and conferences are part of the job

  • Extreme agency and ownership. Self-directed. We expect you to find where developers get stuck and pitch what to build, instead of being told what to do

Nice to Have

  • You've built on Solana or know its data model well: accounts, transactions, RPC, onchain data at scale

  • Prior developer advocacy or technical content work at an infrastructure or devtools company

  • An existing audience in the Solana or broader crypto developer community

  • Experience with real-time data systems like streaming, WebSockets at scale, or gRPC

  • Open source contributions to Solana tooling


Why Helius?

  • High-impact work: Your tutorials and demos become the default way thousands of Solana developers learn to build.

  • A team you’ll shape: You're on a new Developer Relations team, with room to shape how we operate from the start.

  • Real influence: You have direct lines to engineering and product, so the feedback you bring actually ships.

  • Remote-first flexibility: Work where you’re most effective with a flexible, fully distributed team.

  • Competitive comp & perks: Market-leading salary, meaningful equity, generous vacation, wellness budgets, and support for learning and travel.

  • Mission-driven team: Join ambitious builders who move fast, take ownership, and are shaping the future of decentralized apps.

Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Core Services team's mission is to provide exceptional client support across complex financial topics like ETFs, how investments work, and market mechanics. We focus on delivering world-class service while upholding Robinhood's values of safety, clarity, and accountability.

As a Customer Experience Manager, Trump Accounts you will lead a high-performing, customer-facing team and play a vital role in coaching, developing, providing help desk support, and inspiring team members. You'll ensure performance targets are met, elevate the customer experience, and foster an inclusive and energizing team culture. You'll also serve as a subject matter expert on equities and market topics!

The team operates seven days a week from 7:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. ET. Employees will work either five 8-hour shifts or four 10-hour shifts per week, depending on business needs. Specific schedules will be determined after hire.

This role is based in our Westlake, TX office, with in-person attendance expected at least 5 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Coach and develop a team of customer experience professionals, focusing on performance across key qualitative and quantitative metrics.
  • Cultivate a positive, inclusive team culture that aligns with Robinhood's values.
  • Guide your team through change with effective communication and clarity.
  • Respond to complex customer issues and serve as an escalation point for inquiries related to stock trading, corporate actions, and market mechanics.
  • Support your team with expertise in investment-related topics including custodial accounts, IRAs, brokerage accounts, and investor education.

What you bring

  • Active FINRA licensing
  • Prior leadership experience (e.g., Team Lead, Supervisor, or Manager) with a track record of achieving results.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with a passion for mentorship.
  • Deep subject matter knowledge in financial services, specifically equities, corporate actions, and retirement accounts.
  • Comfort leading through ambiguity and organizational change.

This position is restricted to US citizens or lawful permanent residents due to legal requirements.

Leadership expectations

Our ambitious roadmap requires a great culture shaped by exceptional leaders. Here's what we expect from them:

  • Drive high performance by setting clear, focused goals, giving real-time feedback, stretching top talent, and scaling impact through focus, innovation, and tech.
  • Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar, hiring only those who raise it, investing in onboarding, and addressing talent issues quickly and fairly.
  • Create community by connecting work to purpose, removing friction while prioritizing safety, building trust and inclusion, and leading from the front with integrity.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

About Mantle

We’re building an AI agent to help families support their aging parents (origin story here).

 

Over 40M “sandwich generation” Americans currently manage their parent’s affairs. Keeping mom/dad safe and supported is like a second job: it’s time-consuming, stressful and on top of their already busy lives. We believe that managing our parents’ affairs should feel under control, easier and lower stress.

 

Co-founded by serial entrepreneur partners including Ted Zagat, who sold his previous businesses to Slack (announcement here) and Google (Zagat restaurant guides).

The Role

This position is core to our product and company culture. As Founding Software Engineer, you'll architect and build our consumer-facing platform from the ground up. Your job is to create exceptional web experiences that customers love, while integrating AI agents that handle complex family tasks automatically. You'll own significant parts of our technical infrastructure, work directly with founders on product direction, and make architectural decisions that will scale with millions of users.

What You'll Build

  • Consumer-facing web/mobile application: onboarding flows, user dashboards, account management, and all the core web functionality families interact with daily

  • AI agent experiences that integrate seamlessly into the web product, making powerful capabilities feel intuitive and trustworthy

  • Robust, scalable infrastructure on AWS supporting both traditional web features and AI workloads

  • Payment flows, data visualizations, notification systems, and real-time user interfaces

  • Integration layers connecting AI models, third-party services, and internal systems into cohesive user experiences

  • Internal tools and admin interfaces to support operations and customer success

  • Data pipelines and monitoring systems to track product performance and improve the agent over time

 

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

  • 2-10 years building production full stack web applications with modern technologies

  • Strong proficiency in React and Node.js, with demonstrated ability to architect scalable systems

  • Experience deploying and maintaining applications on AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS, S3, etc.)

  • Track record of shipping consumer products end-to-end, from concept to production

Ideal Background

  • Early-stage startup experience (especially as a first-10 engineer)

  • Experience building consumer web applications where UX, performance, and reliability matter

  • Background building features across the full product spectrum - from landing pages to complex interactive workflows

  • Understanding of product development and user-centric design

  • Comfortable working with AI/ML APIs and integrating LLMs into product experiences

  • Nice to have, but not required: experience with FinTech

Who Thrives Here

  • Builders: You love creating things from scratch and taking full ownership

  • Product-minded: You think about user impact, not just technical elegance

  • AI-forward: You embrace modern AI development tools (Cursor, Claude Code, etc.) to move faster and build better

  • Pragmatic: You balance perfection with speed and know when to ship

  • Autonomous: You thrive with minimal direction and maximum responsibility

  • Mission-driven: You care about building something meaningful

What You'll Get

  • Meaningful work: Build a consumer product that will improve the lives of millions of families, with real technical ownership, fast pace, and huge financial potential

  • Small team impact: Work directly with founders and see immediate impact from your work

  • Founding team equity: Significant ownership in a company targeting a massive market

  • Shape the future: You will own all things data science; your decisions will shape our product, business and culture

  • Learning & growth: Exposure to every aspect of building a startup from the ground up

  • Remote Fridays: Work from home every Friday. Monday through Thursday, we build together in person in San Francisco
